name: sidebar-list
title: Sidebar list
description: A titled list of records for the app shell's left pane (NavItem.sidebar): each row an avatar (initial letter) or icon, a label and a count, the open row unfolding its sub-items, a small action beside the title. Built only from the kit's sidebar primitives, so it folds to avatars on the icon rail and keeps the kit's row height and touch floor.
